title: Ali Sharminda Hai
body:
tumhare baad badha dard aur kam na hua
kisi ke dil pe bhi itna bada sitam na hua
qadam qadam pe rahi tum ali ke gham mein shareek
ali ko gham hai tumhara shareek e gham na hua
ali sharminda hai zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
bahot dunya ne tadpaya ali kuch bhi na kar paaya
ali sharminda hai zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
suni kab dard mein doobi tumhari siskiyan maine
na dekhi haye jeete ji shikasta phasliyan maine
na kuch tum ne hi batlaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe khud bhi na tha us waqt apne gham ka andaza
gira jab haye pehlu par tumhare jalta darwaza
madad ko bhi nahi aaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhare darbar mein ummat ke jhutlaya gaya tum ko
ali ke saamne dunya mein tadpaya gaya tum ko
tumhara haq na dilwaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
utaara qabr mein jis dam nabi zaadi ki mayyat ko
kabhi hasnain ko dekha kabhi zehra ki surat ko
yehi ro ro ke farmaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo royega dil shaam o sahar tumse juda ho kar
rahega ye khalaq kaunain ka mushkil kusha ho kar
na mohsin ko bacha paaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shikasta phasliyon ka dard bhi kuch kam na kar paaya
maseeha ko yehi gham hai ilaaj e gham na kar paaya
isi aalam mein dafnaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi jab qabr par aaye baraye fateha khwani
yehi kehte thay rakh kar turbat pe peshani
koi khaatir na kar paaya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
najaf se jab ali ne qabr e zehra par nazar daali
lehed ujdi hui dekhi tadap kar reh gaya waali
ye jumla phir se dohraya
ali sharminda hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho aaj bhi saaya nahi hai qabr e zehra par
kisi ki ye sadayein aa rahi hai aamir o akhtar
zamaane ne sitam dhaaya
ali sharminda hai...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
